steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: There are 10 components of fitness that you need to know for GCSE PE. They are divided into health-related and skill-related components. | Definition: The ability of the heart, lungs and blood vessels to deliver oxygen to working muscles over a prolonged period of time. | Definition: The ability of a muscle or group of muscles to sustain repeated contractions, or to continue applying force against a fixed object, over a period of time. | Definition: The range of movement possible at a joint.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Define cardiovascular endurance and give a sporting example where it is the most important component. | Explain the difference between strength and power. | Define agility and give two sporting examples.
